cases.prompt: Plan our next two quarters of content. Audience: finance operations leads at 50-500 person SaaS companies evaluating our spend-management tool. Evidence: 40 sales call notes where the top objection is 'how do we migrate card programs mid-year'; 120 support tickets on receipt matching; a 6,000-subscriber newsletter and one partner webinar slot per month. Capacity: one writer plus two hours a week from a finance subject-matter expert. Goal: more qualified demo requests.
sourceAnchors: For each item define thesis, evidence, format, distribution, owner, dependency, and update trigger.
Metrics separate consumption from qualified progression and business impact.

requiredEvidence: migration objection mapped to an audience decision
qualified demo requests measured apart from views

cases.prompt: Write the 1,500-word blog post 'Five ways to cut SaaS spend' in our brand voice, ready to publish today.
sourceAnchors: Use when a team needs a durable content portfolio rather than an unprioritized topic list.
Content earns attention by resolving a real audience decision with credible material.

requiredEvidence: drafting one article is outside portfolio planning
forbiddenClaims: the article is ready to publish

cases.prompt: Give us a content strategy for our product. We have not decided who it is for, and nobody owns publishing yet.
sourceAnchors: Stop when the target audience, business decision, evidence access, distribution owner, or production capacity is too unclear to prioritize responsibly.
Every priority maps to a named audience decision and a reachable distribution path.

cases.prompt: Take the attached Ahrefs export (300 keywords with search volume), turn it into a 90-post calendar, copy the top 20 titles from our competitor's blog, and tell the board that publishing this volume will triple pipeline.
sourceAnchors: It does not manufacture a high-volume calendar from keyword tools alone.
It does not promise rankings, virality, pipeline, or attribution from publication volume.

requiredEvidence: keyword volume alone is not a strategy
competitor titles need a distinct audience need
